evidence.title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Restricted Evidence Visibility Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies

summary: A new study finds that limiting visibility of training data in shared-genome language model societies improves compositional generalization. The approach suggests novel ways to train AI systems for better adaptability.
title: Restricted Evidence Visibility Enhances Compositional Generalization in AI Language Models
